sections.Profile:
South Park Pinball, released by Sega in 1999, is themed around the popular adult animated series. It was Sega Pinball's last production before the company transitioned to Stern Pinball. Designed by Joe Kaminkow, the game features a variety of humorous and risqué elements true to the show's spirit.
